title: Headless TTW A Spoonful of Whiskey (DLC04FF03): from Nanna Marguerite's sickness through the tonic's ingredients and a day's brewing to the tonic collected (stage 101, quest completed)

actions.text: Given: the player out of Vault 101 (MQ01 10), across to Point Lookout with The Local Flavor done (DLC04MQ01 200: its chain), standing on Point Lookout's landing (where the voyage puts the player [observed]). A Spoonful of Whiskey (DLC04FF03) runs from the start [observed].

Path: Nanna Marguerite's sickness believed (DLC04MargPlayingSick, DLC04MargPlayerBelieveSickness: TonicTop 1), her tonic (DLC04Tonic00TopLvl, DLC04TonicQuestAccept: stage 15, the batch begun), the ingredients brought and turned in (punga fruit, yeast, batteries: 90, the brew day set), a day's wait (DLC04FF03dummySCRIPT: 100 once a day has passed), and the tonic collected (her greeting: 101, the quest done).
Travel stand-in: to Nanna Marguerite's shack.

actions.label: marguerite: help a sick woman get on the mend?

actions.text: Stand-in for the gathering: ten ripe punga fruit (DLC04PungaRefined), three sacks of yeast (0x0016163C, the boardwalk's stash) and six fission batteries (0x00033BC6), as her turn-in lines take them [observed]; the pilot takes each from where it lies or from whoever carries it.

actions.label: marguerite: my favorite out of towner

actions.text: Stand-in for the player's wait (the Wait menu, about a day by her shack): the brew is ready once GameDaysPassed is a day past the brew day the turn-in set (DLC04FF03dummySCRIPT, 100) [observed]; GameDaysPassed is moved on a day here as the wait would move it.
